close_reason: Reverted: user does not want structured types for JSContact sub-objects. The Value approach in jmap-contacts-types is correct. Only types shared with other crates need Rust structs.
description:
Create crate-jmap-jscontact/ as a new workspace member. Provides typed Rust structs for all RFC 9553 §2 sub-objects that currently appear as serde_json::Value in ContactCard: Name, NameComponent, Nickname, Organization, Title, EmailAddress, Phone, OnlineService, LanguagePref, Calendar, SchedulingAddress, Address, AddressComponent, CryptoKey, Directory, Link, Media, Anniversary, Note, PersonalInfo, Pronouns, SpeakToAs, Relation.

Design: Option 3 — the ContactCard.name/.phones/.emails etc. fields STAY as serde_json::Value in jmap-contacts-types (locked crate, round-trip fidelity preserved). This new crate provides typed structs that callers use via explicit conversion: serde_json::from_value::<Name>(card.name.clone().unwrap()). Unknown extension fields are preserved via #[serde(flatten)] extra: HashMap<String, Value>.

Dependencies: jmap-types (for Id), serde, serde_json only. No async.

Spec: RFC 9553 (~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/references/rfc9553.txt).
title: jmap-jscontact: Typed Rust structs for RFC 9553 JSContact sub-objects
